title: Booking System Demo & Lightspeed Integration Plan
statusLabel: Mocked flow ready for client testing
tldr: The custom booking flow is end-to-end mocked: course → cohort → divers → age check → payment → paperwork → medical → review. An admin panel exists for managing bookings, classes, cohorts, trips, and waivers. Next: ship to the shop for hands-on testing while we wire Stripe and the Lightspeed integration (create customer, mark course purchased, pull and assign an e-learning code from inventory). Trip payments (Square / separate bank account) are deferred to a later iteration.
